values.note: Twelve campgrounds round the north shore and the Santa Ana arm. The 40-ft concrete pads are in Fox and Angler; the other loops have dirt pads. A first-come overflow area takes the spill on busy weekends.

note: Lake Casitas Recreation Area, run by the Casitas Municipal Water District on its drinking-water reservoir: no swimming, wading or other body contact, and pets stay 50 ft from the shore. The lakefront sites are Fox's lake-side deluxe row (even numbers F14-F40), on open grass a few feet above the full lake; Grebe and Mallard have the other good views, which depend on the lake level. A winter snowbird program sells 60-night stays from late September to March. --Claude
summary: Casitas MWD camping pages + 2026 policies PDF + campground maps + imagery/3DEP read; booking site behind human verification (unread). $50 (basic hookup weeknight) to $92 (premium executive weekend); dry basic $40-46 for tents/small trailers; 180-day window from departure; overflow FCFS; showers, dump; year-round. The dry basic sites ($40-46) are described as 'perfect for tents and small trailers' on dirt pads; if AWH reads them as fitting a 23-ft rig, the low would be $40. The snowbird program's $45/night needs 60 consecutive nights, so it is not a nightly price.
